cues.text: Footage from a camera high in a corner of Yukari's dorm room: her bed, her desk, shelves of bags and magazines. Yukari stands alone in the middle of the room in a maid's uniform: a black dress, a white frilled apron and a frilled headband.
Yukari crosses to the door and goes out. A moment later she comes back in with Fuuka following her, and they stop in the middle of the room.
Yukari steps behind Fuuka and takes hold of her. Fuuka starts in surprise.
